crossRefs.note: So Moses listened to the voice of his father-in-law, and did all that he had said.
Instruct a wise person, and he will be still wiser. Teach a righteous person, and he will increase in learning.

Yahweh was with Joseph, and he was a prosperous man. He was in the house of his master the Egyptian.

translations.web: Listen now to my voice. I will give you counsel, and God be with you. You represent the people before God, and bring the causes to God.
translations.bsb: Now listen to me; I will give you some advice, and may God be with you. You must be the people’s representative before God and bring their causes to Him.
translations.kjv: Hearken now unto my voice, I will give thee counsel, and God shall be with thee: Be thou for the people to God-ward, that thou mayest bring the causes unto God:
translations.asv: Hearken now unto my voice, I will give thee counsel, and God be with thee: be thou for the people to God-ward, and bring thou the causes unto God:
